Riverbend Library and Community Learning Center

Welcome to the library

The library is open every day from nine in the morning to eight in the evening. Card holders can borrow books, films and music, use the computers and reserve the meeting rooms.

Summer reading starts on June 1. Sign up at the front desk or online, and collect a stamp for every book you finish.

Our branches host story times for children, homework help for teenagers and classes in computer skills for adults. Every event is free and open to everyone.

Questions about your account, fines or holds can be answered at any branch or by phone during opening hours.

Opening hours for every branch: Central, North, East, West, Riverside and Hilltop, all week long.
